# Environment for the pLM worked example and the bring-your-own-data ablation CLI
# (analysis/plm_ablation_cli.py, analysis/_ablation_core.py, analysis/embeddings.py,
#  and the analysis/*.py worked-example scripts).
#
# This is SEPARATE from requirements.txt (which pins only the audit-test deps:
# openpyxl + pytest). Create a dedicated env, e.g.:
#     conda create -n plm python=3.10 && conda activate plm
#     pip install -r requirements-plm.txt
#
# The BASE-only path (composition + physicochemical descriptors) needs only
# scikit-learn / numpy / pandas / scipy. torch + transformers + sentencepiece are
# required ONLY to compute ProtT5 / ESM-2 embeddings; CPU is sufficient
# (mean-pooling only). Models auto-download from the Hugging Face hub on first use
# (ProtT5-XL ~2.5 GB cache, ESM-2 35M ~150 MB).
#
# Archived local versions: torch 2.5.1, transformers 4.41.2, scikit-learn 1.6.1
# (BASE-only ablations were also reproduced under scikit-learn 1.2.0).

scikit-learn>=1.2
numpy>=1.24
pandas>=1.5
scipy>=1.10

# pLM embeddings (optional; needed for --features prott5,esm2)
torch>=2.2
transformers>=4.40
sentencepiece>=0.1.99   # ProtT5 T5Tokenizer
protobuf>=3.20
